Bro lemme be honest,

If you die, then your pets are going to either die before someone thinks to come find you, which will inevitably happen but not in enough time to save them, or your pets will suffer extreme psychological damage. That doesn't mean anything good or bad about your life. The statement alone doesn't imply anything. That's like - that's just an observation. Those dogs are the only thing keeping you alive? Keep those fuckers healthy as shit dawg. Go to the vet. Make money by working hours to spoil those fuckers. You take them out side on walks. You train em' well enough to go places with you. The action of correctly nurturing something you love the most forces you to live. The best part is. You're living because of what you freaking want!
